olivia: Heads-up we'll toggle ui_feed_v1 behind the flag in the 23:00-00:00 UTC window. Start with a micro-canary.

nate: Confirm ramp and rollback signals pls.

olivia: Plan: 0% -> 3% (8m) -> 15% (12m) -> 50% (15m) -> 100% (cooldown 20m). Fail if 5xx > 1% for two windows or p95 latency + >600ms. Single-window 5xx >=2% -> auto-drain.

emma: Can we pin the 3% canary to feed-index-v1-2026-03-18? Avoid index drift.

olivia: Yes. Adding pin and fallback to feed-index-v0-2026-02-10.

deploy-bot: Deploy started service=feed-api commit=ff9b7 tag=release/2026-03-25 by olivia. Canary: 3% pinned to feed-index-v1-2026-03-18. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-25/notes

infra-bot: Infra check: canary pool has 2 spare nodes, autoscale set. Queue soft-limit enabled for cohort.

emma: Quick smoke (3%): p95 -5ms, 5xx=0.0%, quality metrics OK. https://redwood.internal/evals/3678901234

nate: Go to 15%.

deploy-bot: Rolled to 15% at +20m. Snapshot: p95 +9ms, 5xx=0.12%.

olivia: Proceeding to 50% after 12m. Monitoring dashboards and on-call alerts.

deploy-bot: Reached 100% at +1h. Final: p95 +18ms, 5xx=0.09%. No auto-drain. Audit: https://redwood.internal/audit/3678901234

emma: Leaving pin for 24h, unpin scheduled 2026-03-26 after validation.

olivia: Thanks everyone. Closing thread unless on-call files issues. :white_check_mark:
